message.jaymoskingdoms.youth_wisp.how: Just say "youth" in chat and ask me. Lost? Cry "help!" while I'm in sight and I'll fly you to your bed.
message.jaymoskingdoms.youth_wisp.hold.2: I'd have to check. Back in a moment!
message.jaymoskingdoms.youth_wisp.hold.3: Ooh, good one. Let me go look it up!
message.jaymoskingdoms.youth_wisp.hold.4: Off to ask the elders. Back soon!
message.jaymoskingdoms.youth_wisp.hold.5: That needs some reading. Be right back!
message.jaymoskingdoms.youth_wisp.home.1: Hold on tight! Second star to the right...
message.jaymoskingdoms.youth_wisp.no_bed: You've no bed for me to fly you to! Sleep in one first.
message.jaymoskingdoms.youth_wisp.bed_go: Your bed's gone! I can't find the way.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.youth.0: Got a question about how the world works? Just say "youth" aloud. Something small comes to answer.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.youth.1: My gran swore by it: say "youth" and the elders' wisp comes and answers you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.youth.2: Don't ask me, ask the wisp. You know its name. Just say it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.youth.3: There's a little green thing with wings that comes when it's called by name. Young-looking. Always young-looking.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.youth.4: The Sylvan elders forget nothing, they say. Their wisps carry it to anyone who asks aloud.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.youth.5: If you're ever lost and a wisp's in sight, cry for help. It'll have you home in your bed before you blink.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.youth.6: I said its name once, half joking. And there it was, turning cartwheels in the air, grinning at me.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.youth.7: The children shout "youth!" in the fields all day. Half the time something answers.
